items.detail: **Wednesday's Fed minutes** from the September meeting, the Fed's first hike since 2023, are the week's main event, with October hike odds already down to the mid-teens.
items.why: A hawkish tone could revive hike bets and push yields higher again. Talk of a pause would extend Friday's rally.

items.detail: A **$39 billion 10-year auction** comes Wednesday, an hour before the minutes, and a **$22 billion 30-year** follows Thursday, with long yields near 2002 highs.
items.why: Weak demand at either auction would lift yields and cap the rate-sensitive megacaps behind the Nasdaq's gain last week.

items.detail: Earnings season opens with **PepsiCo Thursday** and **Delta Friday**, and no megacap tech names report, so the **S&P 500** enters at 7,722.72 driven by rates, not profits.
items.why: Delta will show how much $100 oil hurts margins, and PepsiCo whether consumers still accept higher prices.

items.detail: **Mainland China reopens Thursday** after Golden Week as Stock Connect resumes, and **Brazil's September inflation** comes Friday after a 0.70% preview reading.
items.why: Pent-up holiday flows will set China's direction, and a hot Brazil print would keep its rates high and weigh on EM.

items.detail: The **RBI decides Wednesday**, with many economists expecting a hike from **5.25% to 5.50%**, and **TCS** opens results season Thursday after the market closes.
items.why: A hike is largely expected after weeks of foreign selling. A hold or hawkish surprise would decide whether outflows ease.

items.detail: The US **Russell 2000** enters near **2,833** after six straight weekly losses, and Wednesday's Fed minutes and 10-year auction will test it.
items.why: Small firms carry more floating-rate debt, so lower yields and signs of a Fed pause help them most.

items.detail: **Bitcoin** enters the week above **$85,000** after three straight weeks of ETF inflows, and Wednesday's Fed minutes are its main macro test.
items.why: Bitcoin has traded on hike odds. Minutes that point to a pause would help ETF buying continue.

items.detail: **Ether** sits near **$2,690**, below its $2,800 ceiling, as the **Glamsterdam upgrade** goes live on the Sepolia test network Tuesday.
items.why: A smooth testnet launch keeps the upgrade on schedule, but ETF outflows still need to stop before ether can break $2,800.

items.detail: **Solana** starts near **$122**, just below resistance at $125, with ETF inflows slowing to a trickle after a record week.
items.why: Without fresh ETF demand, a breakout depends on Wednesday's Fed minutes and how risk appetite holds up.

items.detail: **Spot gold** enters near **$4,217**, with $4,100 as the first support, and Wednesday's Fed minutes are the catalyst most likely to move it.
items.why: Gold pays no interest, so hawkish minutes that lift yields and the dollar would push it lower again.

crossCuttingTheme: Wednesday's Fed minutes and 10-year auction will show whether long yields near 2002 highs can ease, and that path will move stocks, EM, crypto and gold together.
